manual_new_phase_review.method: Read every new native phase alongside its final approved reader phase text. Compared onset precision, endpoint kind and bounds, scope, greater-than-24-hour assessment, continuity, inclusion and duration fields. No new research or independent source claims added.
manual_new_phase_review.result: All 59 new phase IDs and approved phase counts are preserved. One >24-hour follow-up requested for a supported qualitative freight suspension; other dates and qualifications agree.
